schema.description: Per-class evidence profile for discrepancy_class 'constraint' (SDC-next) — analogous to discrepancy-multi-source.json. Full text: docs/history/profiles/intelligence/discrepancy-constraint.md, description.

constraint_id.description: The violated profile constraint id, e.g. spindle_when_in_cycle

constraint_defined_in.description: profileId in which the rule is defined (may be an ancestor via parentType)

constraint_severity.description: Severity of the rule at raise time

constraint_observed.description: Serialized attribute values at raise time (when/require attributes)

constraint_rule.description: Serialized snapshot of the triggering rule version ({when, require, severity}) at raise time. Full text: docs/history/profiles/intelligence/discrepancy-constraint.md, attributes › constraint_rule › description.
